title: Show Queue override marker after save
summary: Keeps the visible Queue table override marker in sync immediately after successful Queue file-override save and clear commands.
reason: Operators need the Override chip to appear as soon as a per-file override is saved, even if the immediate queue refresh has not yet returned backend marker fields.
behavior_before: Saving a per-file override could leave the Queue table row without the Override chip until a later queue snapshot or rebuild exposed backend marker fields.
behavior_after: Successful file-override save, partial clear, and full clear commands update a local displayed marker overlay for the matching Queue row, while normal backend refresh still runs.
manual_validation: git diff --check -- apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/queueView.js tests/webview/test_webview_browser_queue_file_overrides_smoke.py - passed with LF-to-CRLF warnings
rollback_plan: Remove the displayed Queue file-override marker overlay and drawer callback wiring, then revert the focused browser smoke assertions for immediate marker save/clear behavior.
notes:
Ensure saved file overrides update the visible Queue override marker immediately without adding frontend mutation authority.
Bundled Python lacks pytest in this workspace; focused browser smoke was run through unittest and the project PowerShell wrapper.
